summary: Shoshone County tower on the St. Joe National Forest: an L-4 tower went up in 1934, was abandoned in the 1940s and is gone. No source describes the summit today.

facts.status_note: The tower is gone; no source describes what, if anything, remains on the summit.

events.note: L-4 tower atop the southeast point of the peak
Sources give only the 1940s; 1940 is a placeholder for that decade

evidence.supports: 1934 L-4 tower atop the southeast point; abandoned in the 1940s; gone

notes_for_editor: Built year 1934 and the 1940s abandonment agree across three sites; the 1940 event year is a placeholder for the decade. Record fields checked and consistent: L-4 design, gone status, St. Joe National Forest. No source gives a removal date, a current access rule, or what remains on the summit, so access is left out of facts. Second search turned up nothing new.
